description: Spaces around the name in the iterator property are ignored
notes: The README doesn't say how the iterator attribute is read. Read as a static traversal, whose string the JSON syntax reads as a native syntax expression (json/spec.md#static-traversal; see json/analysis/traversal-surrounding-spaces), spaces around the name are allowed, while a string that must be the name itself would be an error. hashicorp/hcl reads the attribute with hcl.AbsTraversalForExpr (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go).
